column1: # comment: "schema.org financial extension alignments for the GMEOW finance slice. schema.org BankAccount/DepositAccount/MonetaryAmount/Invoice/Order/Payment/LoanOrCredit are the clean projection targets."

column6: schema.org has no crypto-specific account term; BankAccount is the closest match. Projection loses crypto-specific semantics: wallet address, blockchain/network scheme, custody/private-key properties, and transaction provenance.
a bank account; GMEOW FinancialAccount is broader (also credit, investment, wallet)
a deposit account is a kind of bank account
a money transfer; GMEOW FinancialTransaction is broader (also fees, interest, refunds)
a quantity of money; GMEOW makes the currency frame explicit via ReferenceFrame
a purchase or sales order; GMEOW Order is a subclass of Agreement
a payment action; GMEOW Payment is a thin subclass of FinancialTransaction
the balance of a bank account
the currency of a monetary amount; GMEOW uses a ReferenceFrame individual, schema.org uses a string code
the numeric value of a monetary amount
